description: Regex Tester — Test a regular expression against text with the JavaScript (ECMAScript) engine. Returns validity (with the engine error if invalid), every match with index/end, numbered and named capture groups, group indices with the d flag, group count, full-match flag, and an optional replace preview ($1, $<name>). Flags dgimsuyv (default g). Warns about patterns prone to catastrophic backtracking. Up to 200 matches, text max 10000 chars. Params: pattern, text; optional flags, replace. Pairs with /v1/ai/regex. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_regex_test
